sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Viber, BeReal, MovieBox, Proton Mail, Proton VPN, TeraBox
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Disable push notifications
Blocks push notifications and the prompt asking to allow them.
Hide ads
Removes banner, interstitial, app-open and rewarded ads.
Hide share options
Removes share buttons from the save screen and centers the saved photo.
Inspect AI requests
Shows the network calls an AI tool makes, such as HTTP requests and Firebase uploads. Keeps a log of them.
Show AI progress
Shows the current stage of AI Remove and Enhance on their loading screens.
Speed up AI tools
Shortens the AI tool wait by polling for the result more often and uploading the photo in larger chunks.
Unlock premium
Unlocks pro tools and removes export watermarks and upgrade prompts.

sources.label: Dhrubo
sources.author: Dhrubo
patch_list: Hide ads
Adds an option to hide banner, interstitial, app-open and rewarded ads.
Inspect AI requests
Shows the network calls an AI tool makes, such as HTTP requests and Firebase uploads, and keeps a log, so you can watch your photo fly to China or the US.
Show AI progress
Reads the current stage off the real network activity instead of the fake progress bar InShot ships.
Speed up AI tools
Shortens the AI tool wait by polling for the result more often and uploading the photo in larger chunks.
Unlock premium
Adds an option to unlock the pro tools, remove the export watermark and hide the upgrade prompts.
